The observed pathway highlights a potential mechanism by which Bosutinib could affect Epha5, through its interaction with Epha8 and subsequent modulation of Ephrin receptor signaling. The evidence supports a direct or indirect relationship between Bosutinib and Epha5, mediated through Epha8.
